notes.title: Kaylie S. Wins Cheyenne Space Flowers Competion
notes.notes:
Kaylie S. won first place in the Space Flowers competition last Saturday with an overall time of 2hrs and 37minutes.  She had the good fortune of having several high value trade routes near the center of the map to start the game, and stumbled upon 2 relatives (including her grandfather) in the first 30 minutes to quickly open up many trade routes. 

After quickly amassing a small fortune, she concentrated on allying as many systems as possible before the first change over. After upgrading her engine to speed 10, she managed to get 18 systems allied in the first hour.  She  then used those influence points to search for lost relatives.  She managed to locate 5 relatives in the first 6 systems she tried.  Ignoring the Baby James systems, she upgraded her weapons, shield and armor and then purchased the pirate bait from The Junkyard and went grinding for power absorbers.  


She parked her ship 600k outside a red system and kept luring in pirate ships until she had collected another 20 or so cargo holds and a red power absorber.  She then moved outside a blue system and destroyed pirate ships until she had a level 1  blue power absorber.  Then she went straight to the first bably James purple system and camped outside of it and collected level 2 and 3 blue and red power absorbers.  Another quick upgrade to a level 4 attack console, and she then hit a few level 1 and level 2 systems that immediately surrendered to her... by the end of the second hour she had 38 allied systems and all of her ship systems at level 4 or better.

She then used indirect influence to bring the last 8 systems up to wary, and began trading with them to finally win the game without having to fight the remaining systems.

All in all it was a great run for her... congratulations kaylie! :)

notes.title: Space Flowers News
notes.notes:
Space Flowers received a few minor changes this week including some variable changes to improve game play.  Family member quests were updated to give more information in order to help locate them.  

- finding your father now gives you unlimited fuel for your starship

- disrupter costs were lowered

- the number of enemy star systems you need to capture to get weapon upgrades has been lowered

- some of the artwork was redesigned and/or replaced

- the introduction section was reworked to add the additional game information

I hope these changes make the game more exciting as some upgrades and quests now occur earlier in the game.  It now takes a little less than 3 hours, on average, to finish all quests and play a complete game.

Thank you for playing... as always, any comments and/or suggestions are always welcome.  If you think of anything you would like added or changed to the game, just let me know and I will consider it :)

~Jim

notes.title: Update 1.5 - DISRUPTERS! Now live...
notes.notes:
Upgrade your ships' weapon systems with both standard and overloaded disrupters!.  These direct fire weapons do not do as much damage to enemy ships as your torpedoes, but they travel much faster... and they get a boost in power each time you upgrade your weapons level.  Great for sniping at the random pirate ships you will encounter!

Disrupters can be purchased from The Junkyard if you have a high enough influence level with the station... and all family bonuses that effect the photon launchers will also improve your disrupters.  Your weapon will automatically upgrade as you increase your weapons level (up to a max of 4 at weapons level 5)… Once you have 50 ship kills, you will be able to buy the hot pink disrupters...


Other stuff:

- random clues were added to help on quests to find lost family members.  The name of the flower race and the quadrant of the starbase they are located on are now stored on the player status page as the information is gathered in the game.

- changed a few more graphic items...


Thanks for playing and keep the suggestions coming!
~Jim

notes.title: Version 1.4 Update now LIVE!
notes.notes:
- Added quests to find lost family members scattered out on different starbases in the galaxy - each one will add unique upgrades to your starship when you find them...
- Numerous interface improvements giving the player more information about their ship status and the galaxy around them...
 - Added additional strategy items player can utilize such as *pirate bait* - this artifact will lure pirate ships to your location when activated...

-and many more quality of life changes...


Thank you to everyone playing... keep the suggestions coming!

~Jim

notes.title: Latest Version 1.3 now live!
notes.notes:
Updated to include the following:

- Random Encounters with Pirate Ships
- New Starbase added (The Junkyard) that sells a new ship upgrade
- New Sound Effects
- Sped up the Buy/Sell procedure at Starbases
- Added more in-game hints for those not wishing to read the docs
- Lowered the number of ships needed to be killed to take a system from 75 to 60
- Lowered the price of additional cargo holds for your ship
.. Renamed flower empires and gave each a new graphic picture...
... Modified ships and weapons for flower empires... some have slower, more powerful weapons and ships while others have faster ships with faster, weaker weapons...
... Modified the Pirate ships to drop energy absorbers from the nearby systems they are preying on... also drop cargo holds...
... Modified Player weapons... normal photons do 25 pts of damage to all colored ships... hot pink photons now do 40 + 5 times the players attack rating...
... redundant drops (power absorbers the player already has) are now converted into 2 additional cargo holds as automatic ship upgrades...

… plus many more gameplay enhancements!

Get your copy today!

notes.title: Space Flowers Updated with new features...
notes.notes:
After receiving player feedback, the following changes were made to the program:

-  Random Encounters with Pirate Ships
-  New Starbase added (The Junkyard) that sells a new ship upgrade
-  New Sound Effects
-  Sped up the Buy/Sell procedure at Starbases
-  Added more in-game hints for those not wishing to read the docs
-  Lowered the number of ships needed to be killed to take a system from 75 to 60
-  Lowered the price of additional cargo holds for your ship
-  Removed some Xbox references from the menus and documentation

Hopefully these changes will enhance game play!

Thanks :)

notes.title: It's Here!
notes.notes:
The new galactic tradewars game Space Flowers has finally arrived!  Grab your starship and head out into the galaxy in search of fortune and fame.  Trade or fight your way to victory - the choice is yours.  Locate the most lucrative trade routes and spend your riches upgrading your starship.  Gain prestige and influence through friendly trading - or just invade and take what you want.  

Beware the imminent galactic invasion of Space Overlord Baby James, though.  Can you defeat the invaders and secure peace in the galaxy?

Space Flowers is great fun for all ages... easy to learn, difficult to master.  Grab your copy today!
